# `get_search_region`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Report the guider star-search region setting.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x73cb0 (64-bit guider build) |

Params are not read. Returns the search-region field of the guider object. A missing camera device or guider object is reported as error 300; there is no separate camera-connected check. The value is INFERRED to be in pixels from the star-search role.

Side effects: Reads one cached guider field.

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 300 | Camera device or its guider object is missing | `internal error` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |
